study_role: second exploratory controller redesign after the 1.5 m/s-floor oracle officially failed

single_controller_change.rationale: A complete forward-camera dropout removes the evidence needed to justify continued forward motion. The prior positive speed floor delayed but did not prevent the collision, so this oracle upper bound performs a bounded controlled stop until the transient sensor outage ends.

success_criteria: eligible terminal record, 100% route completion, zero pedestrian/vehicle/layout collisions, no blocked or timeout infraction, and score_composed strictly greater than 50.0
failure_criteria: any collision, blocked/timeout infraction, noncompletion, or fast-screen cancellation

uniform_termination_rules.low_speed_fast_screen: cancel and mark diagnostic-only if absolute ego speed remains below 0.25 m/s for at least 8 consecutive simulation seconds
uniform_termination_rules.runtime_no_progress: cancel and mark environment-error if both trace and agent log remain unchanged for at least 8 wall-clock minutes

interpretation_limit: This controller choice was made after observing the failed 1.5 m/s oracle and is exploratory. A positive result establishes only an oracle mechanism proof for transient complete sensor loss; it does not validate learned Density UQ or LLM understanding and needs held-out confirmation.
prohibited_expansion: additional route or seed before this oracle result
